query: SELECT n.tenant_id, n.id FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.state = 'deleted' AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observations AS o WHERE (o.tenant_id, o.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS g WHERE (g.tenant_id, g.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources AS s WHERE (s.tenant_id, s.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions AS c WHERE (c.tenant_id, c.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) ORDER BY n.deleted_at LIMIT $1 FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
